description: Returns the hail, thunderstorm wind and tornado events of record for one published U.S. county over about the last three years, from NOAA's Storm Events Database, with the source file and revision named.  Needs no key.  state is the two-letter abbreviation and county is written as in the county page address, for example tn and sumner.  The list of published counties is at https://weatherofrecord.com/api/v1/storms.  County level only, never a street address.  The absence of a record is not evidence that an event did not occur.

county.description: County as in the page address, e.g. sumner or virginia-beach-city

name: get_county_storm_history
title: Get a county's storm history
